name: Code
why: A repo's code, from measured to simplified, deleted, explained, checked and held small
ideal: Code stays small and plain: the worst function is split first, unused lines are deleted, shared functions say what they do.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: Code metrics, cyclomatic complexity
GitHub Docs: Code Quality metrics and scores reference
Anthropic: Effective context engineering for AI agents
Claude Code Docs: Best practices for Claude Code

steps.name: Measure
tools: The Code tab's collector in CI
Python's ast and the TypeScript compiler
steps.rule: Every code file is measured on each push, in every language with functions.

steps.name: Simplify
tools: A split that changes no behavior
steps.rule: The most complex function is split first, down to the complexity limit.

steps.name: Delete
tools: git history, which keeps what is deleted
steps.rule: Unused code is deleted, never kept in case.

steps.name: Explain
steps.rule: Every shared function says what it does where it starts.

steps.name: Check
steps.rule: The checks every change waits on stay quick, so a refactor is proved in minutes.

steps.name: Hold
tools: The Code tab on every push
steps.rule: Each area still fits one context window after the change.
